subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is Ava from <Picture 1>, a complete character sheet whose face close-up, front, side and back panels show the same young woman in one current state. She has long straight black hair, brown eyes, balanced facial proportions, a small beauty mark beside one eye, a slender neck and build, and a faint gray-brown closed linear mark on one arm. Her outfit is a fitted beige tank top, matching slim belted trousers with visible back pockets, and light beige lace-up sneakers.
<Subject 2> is Madison from <Picture 2>, a complete character sheet whose face close-up, front, side and back panels show the same young woman in one current state. She has shoulder-length wavy brown hair with loose bangs, light brown eyes, a soft oval face and composed features. Her outfit is a pink buttoned pajama top with white collar piping, white cuff piping and a white-trimmed chest pocket, matching pink drawstring pajama trousers, and beige open-heel backless mule slippers that expose her heels.
<Subject 3> is the post-apocalyptic ocean from <Picture 3>, used as the environment. It contains a storm-dark sea with towering gray-blue waves, a heavily rusted and listing vintage ocean liner with two red-and-black funnels, broken masts, rigging, weathered white deck structures, a dark damaged bow, floating wreckage and a ruined small boat. Heavy storm clouds cover the sky, with a cold break of gray light behind the waves. The shark visible in this image is not a separate creature; the dedicated shark identity is <Subject 4>.
<Subject 4> is the giant shark from <Picture 4>, a complete creature model sheet whose front, side, rear and close-up panels depict the same animal in one current state. It has a dark slate-blue dorsal body, white underbelly, rough textured shark skin, black eyes, visible gill slits, a tall pointed dorsal fin, broad pectoral fins, a crescent tail and multiple rows of sharp triangular teeth in very large jaws.

summary:

As <Subject 1> falls toward the churning sea, <Subject 4> rises beneath her with open jaws. The character, environment and shark references preserve their established identities, materials and designs without reproducing the reference-sheet layouts.

detailed_description:
Cinematic semi-realistic 3D rendering with coherent storm lighting, contact shadows and visible fabric, hair, metal and wet-surface materials. Characters and the wrecked ocean liner share the same dimensional realism, while all reference-sheet panel borders, repeated figures and display backgrounds are excluded.

[Shot 1] In an extreme wide establishing shot, the giant rusted ocean liner from <Subject 3> rolls steeply across a churning dark sea beneath heavy black clouds. The camera begins over the tilted deck and slowly pushes along its sloped wet surface toward the starboard rail, ending with a slight downward tilt that reveals the waves below. <Subject 2>, in her pink piped pajamas and beige open-heel mule slippers, drives <Subject 1>, in her beige tank top and trousers, backward across the canted deck toward the edge. Ava’s arms come up defensively while Madison stays close and controls the retreat. Beneath the ship, between white-capped swells and floating wreckage, the tall dorsal fin of <Subject 4> briefly cuts through the water. Huge waves slam the hull, the metal structure groans and twists, and storm wind howls across the deck.

[Shot 2] At 00:04.000, the camera cuts to a close shot held nearly still as <Subject 2> grips the front of <Subject 1>’s tank top near the rail. Madison’s lips form a cold smile, and <Subject 2> (S1) gives a low, mocking laugh while the ship groans around them. She looks directly at Ava and says in cold, taunting American English, her visible lip movements synchronized to the en-US speech, <d>[English] Big sister, go feed the fish.</d> The cloth pulls tight in her fists with a rough wrenching sound. At the end of the taunt, the camera makes a short sharp forward rush as Madison shoves both hands hard into Ava’s shoulders. Ava’s upper body snaps backward, her feet lose traction on the tilted wet deck, and her balance shifts toward the rail. The ship lets out a violent creak beneath them.

[Shot 3] At 00:08.000, the camera cuts to a steep high-angle full shot and immediately follows <Subject 1> downward. She tips backward over the rail, her black hair whipping upward and her hands grasping empty air as she falls toward the sea. <Subject 2> remains above at the rail while the camera drops with Ava, the wrecked hull sliding past at the top of frame. Below her, <Subject 4> lifts its massive head from the waves and opens its jaws, showing rows of triangular teeth against its white underbelly and dark slate-blue skin. <Subject 1> (S2) takes a sharp involuntary breath, rushing wind streams past her, and the roar of the waves surges louder as the shark waits below.

overall_soundscape:
The scene is dominated by storm wind, massive waves striking the hull and the deep groan of twisting metal. Fabric wrenches during the grab, Ava’s sharp breath cuts through the fall, and the rush of wind intensifies as she drops. The shark’s movement is submerged in the growing roar of churning water.
